BACKEND API TEST INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Authentication uses Cookie-based JWT. For authenticated requests, set cookie header: Cookie: auth_token=<JWT_VALUE>. Do NOT use Bearer token header except for GET /api/auth/me which uses Authorization: Bearer.
2. To get a valid JWT, first POST /api/auth/signin with {email: test_pawal@yopmail.com, password: Wlink123} and extract the token from the response.
3. POST /api/auth/signup returns HTTP 201 (not 200) on success.
4. POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns 200 for BOTH known and unknown emails (anti-enumeration).
5. GET /api/media returns {media: [...]} object, not a raw array.
6. GET /api/auth/me uses Authorization: Bearer <token> header, not cookie.
7. All /api/stripe/* endpoints that require auth use the auth_token cookie.
8. Currency is in NPR (Nepali Rupees).
9. The app is Next.js 15 with App Router.
10. For role-based tests: our test user has role AGENCY_OWNER.
